# Agent Chess

Agent Chess runs local chess matches for humans, engines, and external agents.

## Start

- Require Node.js 22 and npm 10 or later.
- Install: `npm ci`
- Diagnose: `npm run doctor`
- Doctor checks Node.js 22, npm 10 or later, installed dependencies, and port availability when host policy allows the probe.
- Run: `npm start`
- Open: `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Smoke test: `npm run smoke -- --server http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Test: `npm test`

## Agent Procedure

- Read: `/AGENTS.md`
- Read: `/docs/reference/AGENT_API.md`
- Start Agent Chess locally, then create an agent match in the browser.
- Use **Copy full prompt** or **Copy link only** to create a short-lived, one-use invitation link.
- Give the browser-created link to the external agent.
- Client: `/public/agent-play.js`
- Keep capabilities and sessions private.
- Use FEN and legal UCI moves as authoritative data.
- Submit moves before commentary.
- Wait for server acceptance.

## Security

- Use loopback by default.
- Do not expose this alpha service to an untrusted network.
- Read: `/SECURITY.md`
